The '''CZ-series secretary/comm droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] series produced by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] The CZ-series was released as Serv-O-Droid began to wane in its position as a dominant droid manufacturer.

==Characteristics==
[[File:CZsecretary_egtd.png|thumb|left|150px|CZ schematics]]
Its built-in [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] had a surface-to-orbit range. The droid could phase between frequencies to prevent its communications from being intercepted and was also equipped with scrambler, jammers, and encryption algorithms.<ref name="EGD" /> Common job functions included taking dictation, organizing files, scheduling, and making calls. It was modeled after the [[Stacchati/Legends|Stacchati]] species. It had a preloaded number of languages, and it knew all modern and old business regulations and tax codes for thousands of governments. It had a vast data storage capacity<ref name="EGD" /> protected by an almost-impossible-to-crack firewall. [[Slicer/Legends|Slicers]] had developed ways to work around those firewalls, but, providing the owners regularly changed the codes, there was no trouble.<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

It had sophisticated programming that allowed the droid to act as a switchboard for all incoming audio comlink communications, text and data messages from planetary networks, and holographic messages from the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. An owner could synch up his comlink, [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and other communication devices with the droid and have messages forwarded based on predetermined criteria.<ref name="SGD" />

At launch, the droids boasted a garish green-and-orange paint job with yellow highlights, hoping that it would draw attention in stores. Almost every droid was repainted.<ref name="NEGD" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CZ3BTS-DB.jpg|thumb|Early concept drawing of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. His chest plate would eventually be used for [[CZ-3/Legends|CZ-3]].]]

The physical appearance, such as the chest plate, of the CZ-droid model is derived from an early conceptual sketch for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
